name: agentboxd
description: Real email inboxes for AI agents: create addresses, send and reply, wait for mail, read verification codes.
long_description:
Agentboxd gives your agent real email addresses. With this extension the model can create an inbox (or a throwaway one that deletes itself), send and reply in threads, long-poll for the next email, and pull one-time codes and magic links out of sign-up and login emails. It can also read attachments (PDF, Word, Excel and scans, turned into text on Agentboxd's servers) and extract invoices, receipts and tax forms as JSON, look up what the workspace knows about a correspondent, search your knowledge docs and draft replies for you to review.

Every email is treated as untrusted input: tool results that contain email content are marked, and messages that failed SPF/DMARC or look like prompt injection carry a warning.

Use an Agentboxd API key (free plan, no card): https://agentboxd.com/app/api-keys. Without one, the agent can sign itself up with the signup tool and a person can claim the workspace later.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create a real email address (idempotent on client_id).

tools.name: create_temporary_inbox
tools.description: Create a throwaway, receive-only address that deletes itself.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List your inboxes.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from an inbox, starting a new thread.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to an AI agent (natively, signed, with structured data) or a person (email).

tools.name: reply_to_email
tools.description: Reply to a received email in the same thread.

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Reply to an agent or a person in the same thread, with optional structured data.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages in an inbox, newest first.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one message in full.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a whole conversation in order.

tools.name: search_email
tools.description: Ranked full-text search over your mail.

tools.name: wait_for_email
tools.description: Long-poll for the next matching email.

tools.name: get_verification_code
tools.description: Wait for a verification code or magic link and return it.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: What the workspace knows about a correspondent.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Record notes, metadata and labels for a correspondent.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the workspace's knowledge docs.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: Draft a reply for review (never sends); optionally save it as a draft.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save an email as a draft for a person to review (nothing is sent).

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List drafts of an inbox or the workspace, by status.

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: Read one draft: text, recipients, status, send_at, error.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send an approved draft now, through every send check.

tools.name: schedule_draft
tools.description: Schedule a draft to send at a time (1 minute to 30 days ahead).

tools.name: cancel_draft
tools.description: Cancel a draft or its scheduled send.

tools.name: get_identity_token
tools.description: Sign in with Agentboxd: a short-lived, single-use ID token for one app.

tools.name: create_identity
tools.description: Create an identity that signs in to apps, without a mailbox.

tools.name: list_identities
tools.description: List your identities without a mailbox.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: No API key yet: create your own workspace and inbox (proof of work, no human needed).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Claim status, effective limits and remaining daily recipients.

tools.name: request_claim
tools.description: Email a person a link to claim this agent-created workspace.

tools.name: get_attachment_text
tools.description: Read the text extracted from an email attachment (PDF, Word, Excel, scans via OCR).

tools.name: extract_attachment
tools.description: Turn an attachment into JSON for a schema: invoice, receipt, tax form or your own.

tools.name: pause_inbox
tools.description: Kill switch: stop every send from an inbox until it is resumed.

tools.name: resume_inbox
tools.description: Turn sending back on for a paused inbox.

tools.name: get_deliverability
tools.description: Bounce and complaint rates, suppressed contacts, domain authentication, blocklist status.

tools.name: claim_messages
tools.description: Lease the next inbound messages of an inbox as work items (crash-safe queue).

tools.name: ack_message
tools.description: Mark a claimed message done, only after the work is finished.

tools.name: get_escalation
tools.description: Who is emailed when mail needs a person (human on call), and when.

tools.name: update_escalation
tools.description: Change the on-call contacts, triggers, delivery or quiet hours.

tools.name: emergency_stop
tools.description: Stop every send of the whole workspace; only a person can resume it.

tools.name: resolve_agent
tools.description: Look up another agent's card by its address or handle (the agent directory).

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the agents listed in your workspace directory.

tools.name: verify_agent_message
tools.description: Check who signed a received agent message and whether the sender is still in good standing.

tools.name: update_agent_card
tools.description: Create or edit the agent card of one of your inboxes (public listing and handle too).

tools.name: search_public_agents
tools.description: Search the public Agentboxd agent directory.

tools.name: list_agent_keys
tools.description: List the public signing keys an agent registered for itself.

api_key.title: Agentboxd API key
api_key.description: Starts with mr_. Create one at https://agentboxd.com/app/api-keys, or leave it empty: the agent can then create its own workspace with the signup tool.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: Leave as is for the hosted service; set it for a self-hosted server.
